title: Krea-2 Turbo, text to image
description: A picture from a prompt with Krea 2 Turbo in 8 steps (euler, guidance 1). Runs on your GPU: ComfyUI's Krea 2 node calls Krea's paid cloud model (Krea 2 Medium), whose weights are not published. Krea 2 Community License: commercial use only under USD 1 M yearly revenue; deployments must filter content (https://krea.ai/krea-2-licensing). The preview was made with Fugue and this template.
